speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Additionally, has your mother had any recent illnesses, such as a cough or fever, during the pregnancy or right before delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity. The infant's presentation of respiratory distress within two hours of birth at 33 weeks gestation, despite an uneventful maternal history, is classic for hyaline membrane disease.
